test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 29 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate set of words to fill the blanks.

I was trying to ________ a pen to sign a form as my brother had been ________ Rupees 500 for breaking the traffic rules.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**find**" is appropriate in the first blank as it refers to searching or locating something, such as a pen.
 
• The word "**fined**" is appropriate in the second blank as it indicates a monetary penalty imposed, such as for breaking traffic rules.
 
• The other options do not fit the context logically or grammatically.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *I was trying to find__ a pen to sign a form as my brother had been __fined__ Rupees 500 for breaking the traffic rules.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Lend:** means to give something temporarily. (e.g., lend a pen)
 
• **Find:** means to locate or discover something. (e.g., find a pen)
 
• **Fined:** refers to imposing a monetary penalty. (e.g., fined for breaking a rule)
